$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every Azure + GCP alert and cost guardrail (billing budgets/quotas AND infra-health/error alerts). Each block below has its own $comment explaining what it configures and which script/template consumes it. Existing top-level keys (alertEmail, thresholds, gcp, azure) and their nested paths are UNCHANGED on purpose -- ~15 PowerShell scripts (apply/migration/access-control scripts under infra/) read them by exact dotted path today, so this reorg only ADDS structure (comments + two new sections) rather than renesting the existing ones. Monthly cloud budgets use a 30-day planning month: the 140 INR/day local development quota includes 120 INR local and 20 INR canary; prod receives 60 INR/day. Edit identifiers for a new account, then run the idempotent GCP and Azure apply scripts.

thresholds.$comment: BILLING (cost). Percent-of-budget notification thresholds shared by Azure Consumption Budgets and GCP Cloud Billing Budgets. Notify-only -- see azure.cutoff / gcp.shutoffEnabled below for the (separate) hard-stop mechanisms.

gcp.$comment: BILLING + REAL-TIME THROTTLING (cost), GCP side. operatorAccount/billingAccount/opsProject identify the account; environments[].budget* feed GCP Cloud Billing Budgets (infra/gcp/apply-billing-guardrails.ps1, notify-only); quotas[] below are the only layer that actually REJECTS calls in real time (gcloud quotas preferences); shutoff* configures the Pub/Sub-triggered billing-detach backstop (infra/gcp/billing-shutoff/main.py), currently disarmed via shutoffEnabled=false.

azure.$comment: BILLING (cost), Azure side. operatorAccount/subscriptionId/tenantId identify the account; environments[].budget* feed Azure Consumption Budgets (infra/azure/apply-billing-guardrails.ps1, notify-only -- Azure budgets cannot stop resources by themselves). cutoff configures the ONE hard-stop mechanism Azure has: an Automation Account runbook (infra/azure/budget-cutoff-runbook.ps1) wired to the global budget's Actual100 notification, which stops Container Apps/Jobs and disables Azure OpenAI public access across canary+prod. See docs/operations/azure-billing-guardrails.md.

gcpQuotaAlertPolicies.$comment: INFRA/ERROR ALERT (not billing), GCP side. Fires a GCP Monitoring alert policy when any entry in gcp.quotas above rejects a call (serviceruntime.googleapis.com/quota/exceeded). Consumed by infra/gcp/apply-billing-guardrails.ps1, which previously hardcoded these same values inline -- moved here so they're visible without reading the script. Notifies the 'Owner email' channel (created from alertEmail above if absent); auto-closes if the condition stops recurring.

azureInfraHealthAlerts.$comment: INFRA/ERROR ALERTS (not billing), Azure side. Azure Monitor log/metric alerts on application & infra HEALTH -- errors, chat latency, provider throttling/circuit-breaker state, cache miss rate, Cosmos DB 429s. Prod-only, gated behind main.bicep's enableFailureAlerts param (off by default; see infra/prod.bicepparam). Consumed by infra/main.bicep via loadJsonContent() -- this JSON is the source of truth for severity/window/threshold; the KQL query bodies still live under infra/queries/*.kql (queryFile below) since Bicep's loadTextContent() requires a literal path per file. See docs/operations/operations-slos.md.

failureAlert.description: Alerts on PII-safe application, chat, or tool failure records.

operationalAlerts.name: chat-latency-burn
operationalAlerts.description: Alerts when at least five chat operations have a p95 above 120 seconds.

operationalAlerts.name: model-throttling
operationalAlerts.description: Alerts when model throttling is repeated and exceeds 20 percent of chat operations.

operationalAlerts.name: provider-circuit-open
operationalAlerts.description: Alerts when one provider circuit remains observably open for at least five minutes.

operationalAlerts.name: cache-degradation
operationalAlerts.description: Alerts when at least twenty cache accesses have a miss rate of 50 percent or more.

cosmosThrottlingAlert.description: Alerts when Cosmos DB returns at least twenty throttled requests in fifteen minutes.
